error_sva.title: Subject-Verb Agreement
error_sva.janie_message: Watch out for those plural subjects! Let's lock down your SVA to stop leaking marks.
error_sva.janie_message_zh: 注意主謂一致性 (SVA)！特別是複數主語。讓我們練習一下，別再這裡失分。

error_tense.title: Tense Consistency
error_tense.janie_message: Mixing up your tenses can confuse the marker. A 5-minute drill will fix this right up!
error_tense.janie_message_zh: 時態混亂會令考官感到困惑。5 分鐘的時態一致性練習能幫你解決這個問題！

error_countable.title: Countable/Uncountable Nouns
error_countable.janie_message: Common nouns like 'advice' or 'information' can be tricky. Let's master them.
error_countable.janie_message_zh: 'Advice' 或 'information' 這些不可數名詞最容易出錯。讓我們一次過學好它們。

error_wordform.title: Word Form (Part of Speech)
error_wordform.janie_message: Using a noun where an adjective should be is a common Level 3 mistake. Let's fix that.
error_wordform.janie_message_zh: 將名詞當成形容詞用是常見的 Level 3 錯誤。讓我們糾正這一點。

error_inversion.title: Inversion Mastery
error_inversion.janie_message: Want to impress the Level 5** markers? Using 'Not only... but also' correctly is a game changer.
error_inversion.janie_message_zh: 想給 Level 5** 考官留下深刻印象？正確使用 Inversion (倒裝句) 是關鍵。

error_subjunctive.title: Subjunctive Mood
error_subjunctive.janie_message: Sophisticated hypotheticals require the subjunctive mood. It's a hallmark of elite writing.
error_subjunctive.janie_message_zh: 高層次的假設語句需要使用虛擬語氣 (Subjunctive Mood)。這是精英寫作的標誌。

error_participle.title: Participle Phrases
error_participle.janie_message: Concise and elegant. Participle phrases will make your paragraphs flow like a pro's.
error_participle.janie_message_zh: 分詞短語 (Participle Phrases) 能讓你的段落像專業作家一樣流暢簡潔。

error_cohesion.title: Advanced Cohesion
error_cohesion.janie_message: Don't just use 'Moreover'. Let's explore advanced ways to link your complex arguments.
error_cohesion.janie_message_zh: 別只會用 'Moreover'。讓我們探索更多高級的銜接技巧，連結你的複雜論點。
